title: Stir Fry Peruvian Chicken with Dates
description: A Japanese-inspired dish with the bold flavors of Peruvian cuisine. This stir fry recipe combines juicy chicken with sweet dates and a nutty twist.
instructions: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, and Peruvian chili flakes. Add the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
2. Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
4. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
5. Add the dates to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken.
6. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the dates are slightly caramelized.
8. Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
